prompt: Name one of NATO's twelve original member countries.
label: Getting Harder
source: NATO, founding members and the North Atlantic Treaty of 4 April 1949: https://www.nato.int/
valueLogic: The large western powers come first. The Benelux and Nordic founders sit in the middle. Portugal, Luxembourg and Iceland are the tail - Portugal because people assume it joined later, Luxembourg for its size, and Iceland because an alliance member with no army is counterintuitive.
note: Later members (Germany, Greece, Turkey, Spain...) are non-busting distractors: naming one is a reasonable mistake. England is accepted for the United Kingdom, as elsewhere.

answers.name: United States
answers.fact: Its commitment to Europe's defence was the point of the treaty, which was signed in Washington.

answers.name: United Kingdom
answers.fact: A founding signatory, and one of the principal drafters of the treaty.

answers.name: France
answers.fact: A founding member, though it left the integrated command from 1966 to 2009.

answers.name: Canada
answers.fact: A founding member, and with the US one of the two North American signatories.

answers.name: Italy
answers.fact: A founding member in 1949, only four years after the war ended.

answers.name: Belgium
answers.fact: A founding member, and host of NATO headquarters in Brussels since 1967.

answers.name: Norway
answers.fact: A founding member, and the only original with a land border with the Soviet Union.

answers.name: Denmark
answers.fact: A founding member, which brought Greenland into the alliance's geography.

answers.name: Portugal
answers.fact: A founding member, and the one people most often assume joined later.

answers.name: Luxembourg
answers.fact: A founding member, and by far the smallest of the twelve by area.

answers.name: Iceland
answers.fact: A founding member with no standing army of its own, which makes it unique in the alliance.

distractors.name: Germany
distractors.note: Joined in 1955 as West Germany, six years after the founding.

distractors.name: Ireland
distractors.note: Not a NATO member at all - it maintains military neutrality.
